subject: Timezone coordination for technical deep dive - US/EU/APAC overlap
messages:
From: John Malik <john.malik@acmefin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmefin.com>, Lucas Meyer <lucas.meyer@acmefin.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Technical deep dive — finding overlap windows

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick sync last week. Our architects (Priya and Lucas) are ready for a 90-minute technical deep dive focused on routing/fallbacks and KV cache behavior. They are distributed (Priya in APAC, Lucas in EU), and we want to make sure the Solutions Engineer can walk through a live run.

Can you propose 2-3 windows next week that work for Redwood SRE/SEs? To avoid confusion we prefer UTC-based slots and we can convert locally. Note that Priya is on IST and Lucas is CEST. DST is active in EU right now, so CEST applies.

Thanks,
John
--
John Malik
Head of Platform Engineering, Acme FinTech
john.malik@acmefin.com
+44 20 5555 1234

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: John Malik <john.malik@acmefin.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Technical deep dive — finding overlap windows

Hi John — great, we can definitely run this. A couple quick notes:
- Our SE (Sean) will lead the live run; Vivek (SRE) can cover routing/fallbacks.
- 90 minutes is perfect; we usually block 30 min buffer before/after.
- To reduce conversion mistakes I’ll propose slots in UTC and provide local conversions.

Proposed UTC slots (next week):
1) 2026-06-22 13:00-14:30 UTC (US morning, EU mid-afternoon, APAC evening)
2) 2026-06-23 15:00-16:30 UTC (US early morning, EU late afternoon, APAC late night)
3) 2026-06-24 08:00-09:30 UTC (US night/early morning, EU morning, APAC afternoon)

Quick conversions (approx):
- Slot 1 (13:00 UTC): 06:00 PT / 09:00 ET / 15:00 CEST / 19:30 IST
- Slot 2 (15:00 UTC): 08:00 PT / 11:00 ET / 17:00 CEST / 21:30 IST
- Slot 3 (08:00 UTC): 01:00 PT / 04:00 ET / 10:00 CEST / 14:30 IST

Let me know which of these works or if we should look at a different week. I’ll coordinate calendar invites and include an agenda (attached).

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmefin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: John Malik <john.malik@acmefin.com>, Lucas Meyer <lucas.meyer@acmefin.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 20:40:00 +05:30
Subject: Re: Technical deep dive — finding overlap windows

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the UTC proposals. A couple of constraints from our side:
- Priya (me) is in IST (UTC+5:30) and prefer not to be later than 21:30 IST on weekdays.
- Lucas (EU) prefers after 14:00 CEST.

Slot 1 (13:00 UTC -> 19:30 IST / 15:00 CEST) looks ideal for us. Slot 2 is a bit late for us (21:30 IST) but could work if necessary. Slot 3 would be awkward for John in US.

If Slot 1 is ok for Redwood, please send an invite with dial-in and agenda. We can also record.

Best,
Priya
Principal Architect, Acme FinTech

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmefin.com>, John Malik <john.malik@acmefin.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Technical deep dive — finding overlap windows

Hi all — Sean here. Slot 1 (2026-06-22 13:00 UTC) works for Redwood. A couple logistical notes:
- We recommend the team join with a terminal and a Stable token (read-only) if possible; that lets us show live tailing of request traces and KV behavior. If token sharing is not possible, we’ll demo with a synthetic workload.
- We’ll include an architecture diagram in the invite and a short pre-read (attached).

I’ll create the calendar invite for 2026-06-22 13:00-14:30 UTC and include a buffer until 15:00 UTC for quick follow-ups. Invite will include: agenda PDF, pre-read link, and a short checklist for attendees.

Cheers,
Sean
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Confirmed for 2026-06-22 13:00-14:30 UTC. Calendar invite sent (link below). Attachments: ACME-deep-dive-agenda.pdf and a short pre-read.

Calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123
Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/agenda-acme

Agenda highlights:
- 00:00-10:00 Intro + goals (John, Marissa)
- 10:00-55:00 Live run: routing, KV cache behavior, fallbacks (Sean, Vivek)
- 55:00-85:00 Deep configuration Q&A (team)

See you then — will record and share the recording link after the session.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Lucas Meyer <lucas.meyer@acmefin.com>

Subject: Re: Technical deep dive — finding overlap windows

Thanks Marissa — invite received and accepted. One small ask: can you include an explicit CET/CEST label in the invite title so our legal/security folks don’t get confused when we export to calendar systems that default to CET outside DST? It’s been a mess with historical exports.

If you can add the label (e.g., "2026-06-22 13:00 UTC — 15:00 CEST (DST)"), that would help. Otherwise all good on our end. Looking forward to the session.

Best,
Lucas
Cloud Architect, Acme FinTech
